anomaly: alarm on CNC-05: hydraulic_pressure 54.29 bar below 55.00
conclusion: CNC-05's hydraulic system is genuinely degraded (H2). Its idle steady-state hydraulic_pressure has fallen from about 63.5 bar to a stable 57-58 bar, still above the 55 bar alarm setpoint, while the two sub-55 alarms (54.29 bar at tick 1281 and 54.99 bar at tick 1288) occurred while CNC-05 was cutting job 15 and pressure recovered to about 57-58 bar once idle: across ticks 1289-1302 every reading was 55.96-58.25 bar and essentially flat (mean 57.29, delta -0.10 bar). That signature fits a degraded pump/seal/relief-valve where cut draw briefly dips below setpoint with idle recovery. It rules out H1 (a growing seal leak would keep driving idle pressure below 55 - contradicted by the flat idle readings; the decline actually halted once CNC-05 went idle), H4 (pressure never returns toward ~63 bar; the baseline has permanently shifted down), and H3 (the trend is smooth and consistent across E5/E7/E10, not erratic). CNC-05 is uniquely affected: E2 shows CNC-05 hydraulic_pressure deviating by [-13.38, -13.53] bar versus baseline while CNC-02, the only other machine with hydraulics, is normal [0.21, 0.2], and all non-hydraulic machines are normal. All six machines were screened (E2/E4), so the fault is isolated to CNC-05.
